description: This file defines a PHP interface 'OperatorEscapeInterface' for n-ary operators within the Twig templating engine, specifically for operators with more than one operand. It declares a method to retrieve the names of operands that should be escaped.

classes.name: OperatorEscapeInterface
classes.description: An interface for n-ary operators with more than one operand, specifying a method to get operand names that need escaping.

methods.name: getOperandNamesToEscape
methods.description: Returns an array of operand names that should be escaped.
